notes.gross_profit: Computed as: Net sales + Changes in inventories - Material purchases. 2024: 6735+213-1345=5603. 2023: 7888+687-1864=6711. Note: Swiss GAAP FER format does not present a traditional gross profit line; this computation captures the production margin before personnel and opex.
notes.ebitda: Computed as: Operating result + D&A (PPE depreciation + intangibles amortization + impairment). 2024: 304+368+48+2=722. 2023: 1191+346+44+0=1581. Valuation.json source shows 676 for EBITDA 2024 (using slightly different D&A add-back); we use reported income statement figures.
notes.cogs_proxy: For inventory turnover, COGS approximated as: Material purchases - Changes in inventories = gross cost of goods consumed. 2024: 1345-213=1132. 2023: 1864-687=1177. Alternative method: full cost of sales including all operating costs produces DIO figures not comparable to peers; the materials-only approach is conservative.
notes.average_equity_2024: Average of opening equity (12258) and closing equity (12217) = 12237.5
notes.average_equity_2023: Average of opening equity (12051) and closing equity (12258) = 12154.5
notes.average_total_assets_2023: Average of implied 2022 balance and 2023 (14229). 2022 total equity was 12051; using 2023 total assets 14229 and estimated 2022 approx 14000 = avg 14114.5. Approximated as 14114.
notes.net_debt_2024: Total financial debt (22) minus cash (1103) = -1081 (net cash position). Financial assets (293) excluded from primary net debt calc.
notes.net_debt_2023: Total financial debt (77) minus cash (1683) = -1606 (net cash position).
notes.average_ppe_2023: 2022 PPE net was 2706 (from Note 8 historical). Average: (2706+3029)/2 = 2867.5
notes.average_receivables_2023: 2022 receivables not provided; using 2023 single year value 672 as proxy
notes.average_inventory_2023: 2022 inventories approx. Using only 2023 year-end 7309 (2022 not provided in notes). Estimated 2022 inventory approx 6600 (given +698 change in 2023 per CFS). Average: (6600+7309)/2 = 6954.5
notes.ebit_2024: Operating result = EBIT (no non-recurring items above EBIT line). EBIT 2024 = 304. EBIT 2023 = 1191.
notes.tax_rate_applicable: 20.9% (Biel HQ rate per Note 27). For NOPAT calculation in ROIC.
notes.invested_capital_2024: Equity (12217) + Net debt (-1081) = 11136. Net debt is negative (net cash), so invested capital = equity minus net cash.
notes.book_value_per_bearer_2024: Equity attributable to shareholders 12112m / (28741331 + 115027319/5) bearer-equivalent shares. Company reports equity/registered share = 47.27 and equity/bearer share = 236.37
notes.payout_ratio_2024: Proposed dividend CHF 4.50 bearer / EPS CHF 3.74 bearer = 120.3%
notes.payout_ratio_2023: Dividend CHF 6.50 bearer / EPS CHF 16.76 bearer = 38.8%
notes.roe_dupont_check: 2024: 1.8% reported average ROE per key figures. 2023: 7.3% reported. These use average equity and net result attributable to ALL shareholders (219/12237.5=1.79%; 890/12154.5=7.32%). Consistent.
notes.debt_to_equity_note: Using total financial debt (not total liabilities). 2024: 22/12217=0.002. 2023: 77/12258=0.006. Extremely low financial leverage.

efficiency.inventory_turnover_note: Materials COGS proxy (1345-213=1132) / avg inventory 7475 = 0.151. Note: this is a conservative measure; full cost of sales basis not separately disclosed.
efficiency.dio_days_note: 365 / 0.151 = 2417. Using materials-only COGS. This is very high — reflecting ~2 years of production inventory maintained. For context: the company intentionally holds high inventory as production capacity buffer. Alternative DIO using production cost (materials + labor + depreciation fraction) would be lower.
efficiency.dio_days_alt_note: Using cost of sales approximation including 50% of personnel (production-related est.): (1345-213+1253)/7475*365 = ~115 days finished goods. Finished goods DIO: 3918/(1132/365) = 1263 days for finished goods alone.
